decisions.label: Path bump strength
decisions.note: How strongly the paths' bump maps catch the light (Ed, 2026-11-03: "Can you give them bump maps to make them less flat?"): stones, cobbles, planks and roots lit on the side facing the moon, her glow or a lamp and shaded on the other, joints, gaps and ruts sunk; the path as bright on the whole. 0: flat, as before; 2: as built; past about 4 the bevels go stark. Live: no rebake.
